en.html:
At her words I took my eyes off the document in my hands.

Outside the car window, the escort vehicles kept pace. The streets went slipping past. Beyond them rose that enormous thing, doing no slipping whatsoever.

Close now, certainly.
...This close I had never seen it before, come to think of it. From a distance one can pretend grandeur is somebody else's problem.

The very heart of the Rokuhara shogunate————Fudaraku Fortress.

言われて、俺は掌中の書面から目を離した。

　車の窓越しに景色を眺める。
　併走する警護車両、流れ去ってゆく街路――そして
その向こうに<ruby>聳<rt>そび</rt></ruby>える、不動の偉容。

　確かに、もう近い。
　……これ程の距離で目にするのは、思えば初めての
事であった。

　六波羅幕府の中核点――――普陀楽城塞。

en.html:
Chachamaru"Apun comes all this way and not one bastard comes to receive her. Kya cold-storage people you are."
Shishiku"Nobody called you."
Raichou"Same from my side."
Doushin"Arre, no, no, no, no. You came to the castle so suddenly... Had you given word beforehand, such discourtesy we would never have allowed."
Doushin"Whatever the case, welcome back. This monk Doushin feels he has gained the strength of a hundred men."
Raichou"The headache of a hundred men, you mean."
Shishiku"Let us hope a hundred is sufficient."
Chachamaru"Keep provision for two hundred, safest."
Raichou"Yes, quite! Ohohohoho!"
Raichou"ARRE, WHAT 'YES'!? You shameless little nuisance, useful you had no intention of being in the FIRST PLACE!?"
Chachamaru"Agree also, get shouted at also... Same difficult child. Kya karein with this one."
Doushin"Now, now, shanti. After so long, the Four Kubo are all together."
Doushin"For today at least, let us celebrate meeting again."
Shishiku"Very well. Politics also must be suffered."
Shishiku"What a blessed occasion."
Raichou"Yes. Blessed."
Chachamaru"Do these idiots actually have even one drop of qualification for ruling over other people?"
Doushin"Now, now. ............Hai, what a life."
Doushin"Chachamaru ji, though. There is something I would ask."
Chachamaru"Hm?"
Shishiku"Yes. Me also. ...Who is that fellow?"

ja.html:
茶々丸「来てやったってのに誰も出迎えに来ねえ。 　寒いんだよ、てめーら」
獅子吼「呼んでいない」
雷蝶「右に同じ」
童心「いやいやいやいや。 　あまりに突然のご登城であったゆえ……前 もってお知らせ下さっていればこんな無礼は 致さなかったのでござるが」
童心「ともかく、よくぞお戻り下された。 　この童心坊、百人力を得た心地でござる」
雷蝶「百人分の足手まといの間違いでしょうに」
獅子吼「百人分で済めば良いが」
茶々丸「二百人分は覚悟しといた方がいいな」
雷蝶「そうね、オホホホホホ！」
雷蝶「じゃァないでしょ!? 　端から役に立つ気がないのかあんたは!!」
茶々丸「話を合わせてやったのに怒るし……。 　相変わらずこの子は難しい子ですね」
童心「まぁまぁ、まぁ。 　久々に四公方が顔をそろえたのでござる」
童心「今日のところは、再会を祝いましょうぞ」
獅子吼「宜しかろう。 　これも政治というものだ」
獅子吼「目出度めでたい」
雷蝶「そうね」
茶々丸「こいつら実は、人の上に立つ器量とか全然 無いんじゃなかろうか」
童心「まぁまぁ。 　…………やれやれ」
童心「して、茶々丸殿。 　お伺いしたいのでござるが」
茶々丸「うん？」
獅子吼「あぁ。俺も訊きたかった。 　……誰だ？　そいつは」

en.html:
Kageaki"............"
Chachamaru"Achha, yes! Introduction. Apun's newly appointed adjutant: Lieutenant Colonel Kageaki Minato."
Kageaki"—Minato, at your service. I request that you remember the name."
Doushin"...Ohh..."
Raichou"...Lieutenant colonel?"
Chachamaru"Treat him nicely, haan?"
Shishiku"No, wait. Minato...? We have a field officer by this name?"
Shishiku"Nothing of the sort is in my memory."
Chachamaru"Correct. Why would it be?"
Shishiku"His previous posting?"
Chachamaru"Kya posting? Till yesterday the man was a civilian."
Shishiku"............Then HOW is he a lieutenant colonel today!?"
Chachamaru"Arre, that. You know. The thing."
Shishiku"Which thing?"
Chachamaru"Forgery. Service record and all. This and that."
Shishiku"You are announcing it like an ACHIEVEMENT!"
Chachamaru"Toh what to do? Start from preparatory school, who knows how many years before apun can use him. At a time like this, shall I sit putting a garland on patience?"
Raichou"That does NOT make such a slapdash arrangement acceptable! Honestly, you and your endless—"
Raichou"—I said that automatically. Actually, such outrageous appointments you didn't often make, did you?"
Chachamaru"Never found anybody worth that much outrage, na. Find one, different matter."
Shishiku"Hmph... Big words. This man is worth so much?"
Shishiku"Well, Minato, is it? Your owner is putting a very high price on you...?"
Kageaki"........................"
Shishiku"..."
Shishiku"Silence only. You have some nerve."

ja.html:
景明「…………」
茶々丸「そぅそぅ。紹介しないとね。 　今度新しくあての副官になった、湊斗景明 中佐」
景明「――湊斗であります。 　宜しくお見知り置きの程を」
童心「……ほゥ……」
雷蝶「……中佐？」
茶々丸「よろしくねー」
獅子吼「いや、待て。 　湊斗……？　そんな佐官がいたか？」
獅子吼「俺の記憶には無いぞ」
茶々丸「当然だな」
獅子吼「元の部署は？」
茶々丸「ねえよそんなの。 　昨日まで民間人だったし」
獅子吼「…………。 　それがどうして、今日から中佐なのだ!?」
茶々丸「そこはそれ。あれだ」
獅子吼「どれだ」
茶々丸「捏造。軍歴とか。色々」
獅子吼「堂々と言う事か！」
茶々丸「仕方ねぇだろー、予科に通わせるとこから 始めてたら手元で使えるようになるまで何年 掛かるかわからんし。 　この時期にンな悠長なことやってられっか」
雷蝶「だからって、そんないい加減な話はないで しょうよ！ 　まったくあんたは、いつもいつも――」
雷蝶「ってつい言っちゃったけど、考えてみたら あんた、そういう無茶な人事ってあまりやら なかったわよね？」
茶々丸「無茶やってまで使いたいほどの人間に巡り 合わなかったかんね。 　出会えば、別」
獅子吼「ふん……言うな？ 　これがそれほどの男か？」
獅子吼「どうなのだ、湊斗とやら。 　飼い主は貴様の事を随分と買っているよう だが……？」
景明「……………………」
獅子吼「……」
獅子吼「黙殺か。 　良い度胸だな」

Shishiku"Not as though you don't know what that insolence will bring you. Impressive... the nerve, at least. Nothing else I have praised."
Kageaki"I am honored by your praise, Your Excellency."
Shishiku"————"
Kageaki"However, I only spared myself the work of answering a question for which no answer can be given."
Shishiku"...What are you getting at?"
Kageaki"Whether this Minato is useful or useless, the work will show. By moving the mouth I cannot establish it."
Kageaki"Even if I could, I doubt the Four Kubo would be satisfied with that. So I took the liberty of not answering."
Shishiku"...Hmph. Matlab, you are telling me—"
Shishiku"'Don't ask such bloody stupid questions.'"
Kageaki"Your understanding leaves nothing for me to add, Lieutenant General Ootori. I am much impressed."
Doushin"............"
Raichou"............"
Shishiku"————————"
Shishiku"Not bad."
Kageaki"..."
Shishiku"Not bad at all, this fellow..."
Chachamaru"Hai na?"
Shishiku"Yes."
Shishiku"Not bad."

en.html:
Shishiku"Not bad. Kageaki Minato... that was it, Lieutenant Colonel?"
Kageaki"Yes. I am obliged that Your Excellency has remembered."
Shishiku"Hmph. Cheeky. Not bad. Every word gets under the skin... bloody irritating bastard."
Shishiku"Heh-heh-heh-heh..."
Raichou"...You are frightening me. Your taste also has its own private disease, doesn't it?"
Shishiku"You, of all people, keep quiet on that subject. Chachamaru, though—what mountain did you pick this man off?"
Chachamaru"The anti-shogunate fellows' mountain."
Raichou"Arre, arre."
Shishiku"Oh? A former rebel."
Shishiku"Doesn't look like a man who bends his principles easily. How did you talk him round?"
Chachamaru"Arre, nothing like that. Never had any great pro-shogunate or anti-shogunate feeling. Just kept ending up against it."
Chachamaru"Apun lined up his interests with the shogunate's—our side's—and brought him over. Bas."
Shishiku"Interests, hm. Some personal scheme?"
Chachamaru"Haan. But secret."
Shishiku"Can he be trusted?"
Chachamaru"As much as apun, perhaps?"
Shishiku"I see."
Raichou"KYA 'I SEE'!? As much as this walking fraud means NOT AT ALL!"
Shishiku"Quite right. But... let it be."
Shishiku"Nobody here is trustworthy anyway. ...Hm? Then that was another stupid question from me, was it?"
Shishiku"What do you say, Lieutenant Colonel Minato?"
Kageaki"I believe Your Excellency has correctly identified the problem."
Shishiku"Heh-heh-heh...!"
Shishiku"Chachamaru, give me this man. Take a battalion in exchange."
en.text: Shishiku"Not bad. Kageaki Minato... that was it, Lieutenant Colonel?"Kageaki"Yes. I am obliged that Your Excellency has remembered."Shishiku"Hmph. Cheeky. Not bad. Every word gets under the skin... bloody irritating bastard."Shishiku"Heh-heh-heh-heh..."Raichou"...You are frightening me. Your taste also has its own private disease, doesn't it?"Shishiku"You, of all people, keep quiet on that subject. Chachamaru, though—what mountain did you pick this man off?"Chachamaru"The anti-shogunate fellows' mountain."Raichou"Arre, arre."Shishiku"Oh? A former rebel."Shishiku"Doesn't look like a man who bends his principles easily. How did you talk him round?"Chachamaru"Arre, nothing like that. Never had any great pro-shogunate or anti-shogunate feeling. Just kept ending up against it."Chachamaru"Apun lined up his interests with the shogunate's—our side's—and brought him over. Bas."Shishiku"Interests, hm. Some personal scheme?"Chachamaru"Haan. But secret."Shishiku"Can he be trusted?"Chachamaru"As much as apun, perhaps?"Shishiku"I see."Raichou"KYA 'I SEE'!? As much as this walking fraud means NOT AT ALL!"Shishiku"Quite right. But... let it be."Shishiku"Nobody here is trustworthy anyway. ...Hm? Then that was another stupid question from me, was it?"Shishiku"What do you say, Lieutenant Colonel Minato?"Kageaki"I believe Your Excellency has correctly identified the problem."Shishiku"Heh-heh-heh...!"Shishiku"Chachamaru, give me this man. Take a battalion in exchange."

ja.html:
獅子吼「悪くない。 　湊斗、景明……だったな？　中佐」
景明「はっ。 　御記憶有難くあります、閣下」
獅子吼「ふん。生意気な。悪くない。 　いちいち癪に障る……忌々しい男だ」
獅子吼「くっくっくっく……」
雷蝶「……恐いわよ。 　あんたも何気に趣味嗜好が変よね」
獅子吼「貴様にだけは言われたくない言葉だ。 　しかし茶々丸よ、こんな男を何処の山から 拾ってきた？」
茶々丸「倒幕さんちのお山から」
雷蝶「おいおい」
獅子吼「ほぅ。 　この男、元は叛徒か」
獅子吼「容易く節を曲げるようには見えんが。 　どうやって口説いた？」
茶々丸「いやなに。 　元々、彼には倒幕も佐幕もなくてね。ただ 結果的に幕府と敵対することが多かったって だけでね」
茶々丸「彼と幕府こっちの利害の擦り合わせをして、味方 に引き入れました」
獅子吼「利害、か。 　何か個人的な目論見があると？」
茶々丸「まあね。 　でも秘密」
獅子吼「信用できるのか」
茶々丸「あてと同じくらいかな？」
獅子吼「そうか」
雷蝶「そうか、じゃないっての！ 　こいつと同じじゃまるで信用できんわっ！」
獅子吼「全くだな。 　が……構うまい」
獅子吼「信用などできんのはどうせ誰も彼も同じだ。 　……ふん？　そうなると、今のも愚かしい 質問だったということになるのか？」
獅子吼「どうだ、湊斗中佐」
景明「御自覚の通りで宜しいかと存じます。閣下」
獅子吼「くっくっく……！」
獅子吼「茶々丸、この男を俺に寄越せ。 　代わりに一個大隊回してやる」

en.html:
Chachamaru"Naaah. No chance."
Raichou"W-wait, Shishiku! You are accepting this!?"
Raichou"A REBEL, of all people! We are treating rebellion as a bloody LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION!?"
Shishiku"Yes."
Raichou"Lord Doushin!"
Doushin"Hmm."
Doushin"Well... perhaps there is no harm in allowing it?"
Raichou"You too!? Has everybody's judgment gone on leave together!?"
Doushin"No, no, Raichou ji, your concern is quite reasonable. But this is Horigoe army business. If Chachamaru ji has made her arrangement knowing everything, who are we to sit saying do this, don't do that?"
Raichou"That... is true, but—"
Doushin"One more thing. This gentleman, I know him a little myself."
Doushin"A most interesting man. Different impression from that time, somehow... that also makes him interesting."
Kageaki"...?"
Doushin"What do you say, Raichou ji? Let this old monk bow his head and ask it of you."
Doushin"Chachamaru has returned; it is an auspicious day, after all. Just this favor, please."
Raichou"............If Lord Doushin himself is saying so..."
Raichou"But listen properly, Minato or whatever you call yourself! A man like you, I have NOT decided to trust!"
Kageaki"Yes. I thank you for your generous heart."
Kageaki"Your Excellency, the splendid and elegant Lieutenant General Oyumi."

ja.html:
茶々丸「だーめっ」
雷蝶「ちょ、ちょっと獅子吼！ 　あんたは認めるわけ!?」
雷蝶「よりにもよって逆賊上がりの男を登用する なんてふざけた真似を……！」
獅子吼「ああ」
雷蝶「童心様！」
童心「むう」
童心「まぁ……宜しいのではござらんかな？」
雷蝶「そんなっ！」
童心「いやいや、雷蝶殿の懸念はごもっとも。 　されどこれは堀越軍の事、茶々丸殿が全て 承知した上での差配とあらば、我らがああだ こうだと云う筋合いではござらぬ」
雷蝶「それは……そうですけれど、」
童心「加えて申さば。 　こちらの御仁、それがしもいささか存じて ござる」
童心「なかなかに面白き男。 　あの折とはどうも印象が異なるが……そこ も含めて興味深い」
景明「……？」
童心「如何でござるかな、雷蝶殿。 　ここはそれがしが頭を下げ申そう」
童心「何と言っても茶々丸殿が戻られためでたき 日。ひとつ、どうか」
雷蝶「…………。 　童心様がそう仰るのであれば……」
雷蝶「でも、いいこと？　湊斗とやら！ 　麿はおまえのような男を信用したわけでは なくってよ！」
景明「はッ。 　寛大な御心に感謝致します」
景明「華麗にして優美なる小弓中将閣下」
